"Evening front line,"
Slow watch at the desk, and desk cover came up
Hello team,

I am sending a brief update from the Companion Animal Travel Desk so everyone has the same picture for the rest of the evening. Please keep the tone steady and welcoming with every caller and counter visit, and continue to use calm, humane handling when you are supporting animals and their people. The welcome team has done a solid job preparing passengers for boarding, and that shared effort is helping reduce avoidable stress at handoff.

For rabbit bookings, please continue to check the animal and crate details carefully before confirming anything. <<FACT F064>> <<FACT F070>> Keep the documentation clear, and make sure any notes about carrier fit, ventilation, and comfort are entered plainly so the next shift can follow through without confusion. If you need to pause a conversation to verify a detail, do so politely and return with a clear answer rather than rushing the customer. That approach helps protect the animal and gives the traveler confidence that the journey is being managed well.

For small dog cases, remember that the age rule must be confirmed before we move a file forward. <<FACT F074>> If a record looks incomplete, flag it for review instead of guessing. We are here to keep the process consistent, practical, and reassuring from start to finish, and each of us plays a part in that standard.

Please keep an eye on shared messages, hand over any open items neatly, and pass along anything unusual to the senior coordinator before the end of your watch. Thank you for staying attentive and steady with every case.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
